title: Valid Anagram
statement: Given two strings s and t, return true if t is an anagram of s, and false otherwise.
hints: Count occurrences of each character in s using an array of size 26.
Decrement counts while iterating through t.

solutions.title: Sorting Characters
solutions.complexity: Time: O(n log n) | Space: O(n)
